annotation_policy.unit: logical editorial content region on a single PDF page
annotation_policy.article_columns: Multiple columns of the same article are one region.
annotation_policy.figures: Figures, captions, pull quotes, and project factsheets are included when they clearly belong to the article.
annotation_policy.headers_footers: Running headers, page numbers, and generic publication furniture are excluded.
annotation_policy.whitespace: Large unused whitespace is excluded where practical.

relations.NEW: first occurrence of a logical content item
relations.CONTINUE: direct continuation of the same logical content item
relations.RESUME: same logical content item after an interruption (none in this pilot subset)

annotation_policy.caveat: Pilot annotations are manually inferred from rendered PDF pages and should be reviewed before use as final ground truth.
annotation_policy.single_article_page: If a page contains exactly one logical article region, annotate the entire page as bbox_norm [0,0,1,1]. Explicit boundaries are used only when multiple logical content items share a page.
annotation_policy.advertisement: Full-page commercial ads are labeled advertisement; they receive no article content_id.
annotation_policy.multi_box: One logical item may use multiple non-overlapping boxes when its layout wraps around other logical items.
annotation_policy.image_integrity: Do not split a clearly associated image merely to follow text columns; keep the image intact within its logical item's box where practical.
annotation_policy.visual_container_priority: Prefer one complete bbox around a visually coherent article/advertisement container. Do not split by text columns when the item has a clear unified visual block.
annotation_policy.template: Supervised non-content class for repeated magazine/page chrome (running header/footer, page number, section tab). Parser output may contain it, but it is excluded from article linking.
annotation_policy.content_area: When an issue has repeated page chrome, single-item pages use content_area_norm instead of the physical page.
annotation_policy.cover: Front covers are supervised as label=cover, normally full-page [0,0,1,1]. They are not article regions and do not participate in article linking.
annotation_policy.overlap_with_template: Template/page-chrome regions may overlap article, advertisement, or full-page imagery. Template is a semantic non-content label, not a mask that subtracts pixels from the logical content region.
annotation_policy.front_matter: Page-specific non-article editorial material such as masthead/editorial credits is labeled front_matter, not template. Template is reserved for repeated page chrome such as running headers, page numbers, dates, and repeated footer/copyright lines.
annotation_policy.multi_article_image_rule: For multi-article pages, preserve each complete image with its owning article. If an article is non-contiguous, use boxes_norm with multiple boxes rather than cutting images or assigning one column per article.

revision_log.change: Corrected IAEA p54 NEWSBRIEFS to two rectangles for one logical region.
Applied full-page [0,0,1,1] bbox to 21 single-article pages; retained explicit/multi-box boundaries on multi-article pages.
Merged ESA Bulletin 103 advertisement batch and added four visually reviewed, multi-item pages from ESA Bulletin 128.
Corrected ESA Bulletin 128 PDF page 71: XMM-Newton large image is enclosed by one continuous lower box instead of being split across two boxes.
Added ESA Bulletin 113 In Brief pages with multi-item layouts, cross-page Artemis continuation, and one verified full-page advertisement.
Corrected ESA Bulletin 113 pp.79,81,83: visual article containers kept intact; advertisement page split into two independent ads.
Adjusted ESA Bulletin 113 printed p.79: left New DG region no longer intrudes into the right Ariane-5 article.
Re-aligned ESA Bulletin 113 printed p.79 to the actual colored visual panels, leaving an explicit gutter between the two article boxes.
Re-measured ESA Bulletin 113 printed p.79 from the actual visual panel edges; widened the right Ariane-5 region leftward and tightened the left DG region.
Added 68 template regions and adjusted 22 previous full-page article/ad regions to issue content areas.
Added cross-domain batch: IMF Finance & Development Sep 2023 and UNESCO Courier July 1958, including promotions/ads, multi-item pages, continuations, and template chrome.

Corrected v14 issues noted in review: added IMF Kaleidoscope section title, re-aligned UNESCO Newsroom page 34 boxes, and added the missing 'How to Obtain UNESCO Publications' section title while shrinking the two top publication blocks.

Rebuilt UNESCO Courier 1958 pp.34-35 boxes from original PDF coordinates. Corrected severe newsroom misalignment, restored cross-column Sun Furnace continuation and missing displaced-farmers brief, enlarged both Race Question blocks, and moved HOW TO OBTAIN UNESCO PUBLICATIONS title to its true position.

Added 16 manually reviewed pages: 8 IMF Finance & Development pages covering four two-page features, and 8 UNESCO Courier 1958 pages covering Asian Club, twins, and United Nations in Brussels continuations. Template headers/footers retained separately.
Removed scanned UNESCO Courier July 1958 from the active dataset; retained it as an excluded source for possible later robustness evaluation.
Added 15 born-digital pages from WHO ICPPA 2024, covering seven article/features with NEW/CONTINUE relations and a PDF-coordinate-measured repeated footer template.

Corrected WHO ICPPA batch: split all annotated two-page PDF spreads into individual physical magazine pages, replaced 15 spread annotations with 30 single-page annotations, and regenerated NEW/CONTINUE relations per physical page.
Removed mistaken footer-template labels from WHO ICPPA split pages 5 and 6; restored both article regions to full-page because the lower blue band is part of the feature design.

Full template audit across the active digital-only dataset. Replaced broad guessed header/footer bands with exact PDF text-block boxes, removed empty IAEA header templates, narrowed CORDIS/IMF/ESA templates, and removed false WHO footer templates on split pages 21-22 in addition to previously corrected pages 5-6.
Added three born-digital front-cover examples as a separate COVER class: IMF F&D Sep 2023, WHO ICPPA 2024, and ESA Bulletin 128.

Added 30 born-digital WIPO Magazine Issue 1/2024 pages: one cover plus 29 article pages across seven feature sequences. Only exact PDF page-number boxes were marked as template; no guessed broad template bands.

Rebuilt all 8 active CORDIS pages after visual review. Article regions now use the full editorial band between exact PDF header/page-number templates, fixing omitted bottom lines and preventing overlap with running headers.

Applied overlap-aware template policy. WHO ICPPA single-article pages now remain full-page even when footer text overlays imagery. IMF single-feature/opening-spread pages likewise remain full-page; IMF page 4 promotion is full-page, page 5 is split into podcast ad + masthead, and previously oversized block-based IMF headers were rebuilt from exact top-line words.
Corrected IMF F&D masthead page: right editorial-credits panel reclassified from TEMPLATE to FRONT_MATTER; top-left 'F&D | Masthead' strip marked as the true section-header template.
Raised and re-aligned the IMF Podcasts advertisement box on F&D PDF page 5 to the actual left visual panel (x≈0.06–0.55, y≈0.06–0.955).
Added four reviewed ESA Bulletin 128 programme pages (PDF 80–83), specifically adding multi-article layouts on pages 80 and 83 plus the intervening continuation pages.
Added five additional ESA Bulletin 128 multi-article programme pages (PDF 74–78), covering continuation+new-article mixtures and 2–4 logical items per page.

Corrected ESA Bulletin 128 PDF pages 76–78 after column-flow audit. Restored omitted upper-right continuation text and revised logical ownership: p76 Microscope/Gaia/JWST, p77 BepiColombo/LISA/GOCE, p78 GOCE/CryoSat-2/SMOS.

Major logical correction to ESA Bulletin 128: the TOC shows 'Programmes in Progress' as a single feature spanning printed pp.76–91 (PDF 68–83). Replaced per-mission pseudo-articles with one full-page logical article sequence NEW→CONTINUE across all 16 pages; mission headings are subheads, and all images remain inside the single article region.

Fixed oversized ESA Bulletin 128 running-header template boxes on PDF pp.69–83. Header detection now uses top-of-page word coordinates only; page 72 no longer contains the erroneous large template box.

Rebuilt the entire recently-added multi-article batch from the v33 baseline after visual review. Article regions are now image-aware, may use multiple boxes for non-contiguous reading flow, and never intentionally split a complete associated image. Corrected ESA 128/129/131/103 In Brief pages.

Corrected the four pages flagged in review: ESA Bulletin 131 pp.2-3 and ESA Bulletin 103 pp.10-11. Restored omitted/full-height imagery, reassigned the ICEUM4 group photo to the correct Moon Week article, expanded Eurobot to include its full photograph/right-side continuation, and removed overlapping article text at the p.11 horizontal boundary.

dataset_policy.source_type_scope: Active training dataset includes born-digital PDFs only; scanned/legacy magazines remain excluded.
dataset_policy.spread_handling: If a source PDF stores two magazine pages as one landscape spread, split the spread into individual physical pages before annotation and training. Never train on the combined spread as one page.

excluded_documents.reason: Temporarily excluded because it is a scanned/legacy magazine. Keep source and annotations for possible later robustness experiments.
